entries.english:
Volume 3

Contains: genealogies of the spouses’ families: Manfred Baron von Ardenne and family; Hermann Otto Hans Bauer von Bauern and family; Arnold Carl Philipp von Bauer and family; Karl Hugo von Brauchitsch and family; Dietrich Ludwig Freiherr von Buddenbrock and family; Ernst Max Ferdinand Gustav von Einem and family; the Kekulé von Stradonitz family; the Gesch von Zitzeritz family; the von Heyden family; Charles Louis Jordan and family; the von Kalnein family; the counts of Eulenburg; the counts of Kanitz; the von Treuenfels family; Alexander von Kuenheim and family; the Kummer family; the von Mellenthin family; the von Pape family; the von Ostau family; the von Rosenberg-Gruszczynski family; the Papart family; the von Rothkirch family; Ludwig Adolf Leberecht von der Schleuse and family; Johann Friedrich Michael Ernst von Schwichow and family; the von Schertwitz family; Johann Gottlieb Fichte and family; the von Schönfeldt family; the von Drygalski / Drigalski family; the von Rembowsky family; the von Stuckrad family; the von Sanden family; Christian Ludwig von Kenitz and family; the Wittich family. Copies at the State Archives in Vienna for Hofrat von Calbo.
